# Third-party stylesheets of the Elementor pages (generated, do not edit)

Copied from the live site by `python scripts/audit/export_elementor_pages.py`, together with the files they
reference (fonts, icons). The content of the homepage and of the landing pages links them where the live page
does (inside the page), so they load in the same order. Their `url(…)`s were rewritten to point here.

| File | What it is | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `unlimited-elements-for-elementor/owl.carousel.css` | Owl Carousel 2.3.4, used by the lab-certificates carousel (Unlimited Elements "Content Carousel") | MIT |
| `unlimited-elements-for-elementor/fontawesome-all.min.css`, `fontawesome-v4-shims.min.css`, `fa-*.woff2/.ttf` | Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 (the homepage carousel arrows' chevrons, the plus/minus icons of the /hgh-bali/ accordion) | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT (the header comment in each file is the required attribution) |
| `trustindex-google-widget.css` | The Google reviews widget's CSS, generated by the owner's Trustindex plugin ("Widgets for Google Reviews", GPL on wordpress.org) | GPL (plugin output) |
| `cdn.trustindex.io/*` | The fonts and icons that CSS loads from Trustindex's CDN (Poppins in Trustindex's copy, the Google / verified / quote icons) | Poppins: SIL OFL 1.1; the icons are Trustindex's: see open question Q-34 |
| `atlas-research-planner/tools.css`, `tools-calculator.js` | The owner's own plugin "Atlas Research Planner": the reconstitution calculator on `/calculator/` (its style and its script, which draws the calculator from the configuration the page prints; run by `src/components/elementor/PluginScripts.tsx`). The script's source-map line is removed (the map isn't copied). Phase 6c ports it to this project's code | GPL-2.0-or-later (header of the script) |

Not copied: Fancybox's CSS (`jquery.fancybox.min.css`). The carousel's lightbox is switched off on the live
site (`data-lightbox=false`), so it styles nothing there, and Fancybox 3 needs a commercial licence for
commercial sites.

The carousel itself runs on this project's own code (`src/components/elementor/OwlCarousel.tsx`), not on
Owl's script; the testimonial carousel uses the `swiper` npm package (8.4.5, MIT, the version the live site
runs). All of this goes away when these pages are rebuilt as Sanity content (Phase 4).
